english.title: Water undertaker fail to assist / give information to assessor appointed to enforce water quality
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a

(A)_[water undertaker,]_
(B)_[water supplier licensee,]_
(C)_[relevant person as defined in section 70(1A) of the Water Industry Act 1991,]_

failed

(D)_[to give to **(..SPECIFY INSPECTOR..), an inspector appointed under section 86 of the Water Industry Act 1991 all such assistance]_
(E)_[to provide **(..SPECIFY INSPECTOR..), an inspector appointed under section 86 of the Water Industry Act 1991 with all such information]_

as that person may reasonably have required for the purpose of carrying out any such investigation as is mentioned in section 86(2) of that Act
english.legislation: Contrary to section 86(3) and (6) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a water undertaker / licensed water supplier / relevant person as defined in section 70(1A) of the Water Industry Act 1991
failed to give an inspector all such assistance / provide him/her with all such information as that person may reasonably have required for the purpose of carrying out any such investigation as is mentioned in section 86(2) of that Act

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The Water (Special Measures) Act 2025 amends the penalty for this offence from the 24th April 2025. See H102065 for offences committed from this date.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: a fine not exceeding £20,000.
Indictment: a fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
